description: Defines the Challenge class implementing ChallengeInterface, representing a stateless challenge prompt with various reasons and prompts, used for client validation flows.

classes.name: Challenge
classes.description: A class representing a challenge prompt with various reasons, prompts, and dynamic titles/subheadings.

methods.name: modalTitle
methods.description: Returns the modal title based on the challenge reason.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Returns the main heading for the challenge modal, based on reason or custom heading.

methods.name: subheading
methods.description: Returns the subheading for the challenge modal, primarily for migration reason.

methods.name: hasPromptForValidationType
methods.description: Checks if any prompt matches the specified validation type.
